# `mise generate github-action`

- **Usage:** `mise generate github-action [FLAGS]`
- **Effect:** modifies state
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/generate/github_action.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/generate/github_action.rs)

Generate a GitHub Actions workflow that runs a mise task

The workflow runs the task named by --task on pull requests, tags, manual
dispatch, and pushes to the current branch. It prints YAML unless you pass
--write, which saves `.github/workflows/<NAME>.yml` in the repository root and
replaces an existing file. Define the task and review the triggers before
committing the workflow.

## Flags
- **`-t --task <TASK>`** — The task to run when the workflow is triggered

  **Default:** `ci`
- **`-w --write`** — Write the workflow to `.github/workflows/<NAME>.yml` instead of printing it
- **`--name <NAME>`** — Name of the workflow and its file

  **Default:** `ci`
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

Print a workflow that runs the ci task

```
mise generate github-action
```

Save it as .github/workflows/ci.yml

```
mise generate github-action --write
```

Save a workflow that runs the lint task as .github/workflows/lint.yml

```
mise generate github-action --task lint --name lint --write
```
